title: Northstar Outfitters: the week the dashboard changed
description: A small, presentation-ready replay of business situations a leadership team would actually care about.

scenarios.headline: Revenue is down everywhere, not just in one chart.
scenarios.why_it_matters: This is the kind of movement that deserves a leadership push with the evidence attached.

scenarios.headline: Mobile conversion collapsed while the rest of the business held steady.
scenarios.why_it_matters: A severe mobile funnel failure deserves a leadership push with the affected surface attached, even though the other channels are holding steady.

scenarios.headline: Every channel softened, but nothing crossed the team’s action boundary.
scenarios.why_it_matters: A dashboard movement is not automatically a leadership problem. This should be suppressed without waking an agent for a deep analysis.

scenarios.headline: The dashboard stopped reporting. Do not invent a business story.
scenarios.why_it_matters: A missing source is a data-trust incident, not evidence that revenue moved.
